chemistry-h3-q2.title: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-h3-q2.topic: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-h3-q2.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-h3-q2.material: Kanggo reaksi 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), asil metode laju awal nuduhake yen nalika [O₂] dijaga tetep lan [NO] didobel, laju dadi 4 kali, lan nalika [NO] dijaga tetep lan [O₂] didobel, laju dadi 2 kali. Apa hukum laju lan orde reaksi total reaksi iki?
chemistry-h3-q2.thinking.0: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Kanggo reaksi 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), asil metode laju awal nuduhake yen nalika [O₂] dijaga tetep lan [NO] didobel, laju dadi 4 kali, lan nalika [NO] dijaga tetep lan [O₂] didobel, laju dadi 2 kali. Apa hukum laju lan orde reaksi total reaksi iki?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.explain: Amarga laju dadi $4$ kali nalika $[\text{NO}]$ didobel, $m=2$, lan amarga laju dadi $2$ kali nalika $[\text{O}_2]$ didobel, $n=1$. Hukum laju yaiku $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, lan orde reaksi total yaiku $2 + 1 = 3$.

chemistry-h3-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

chemistry-h3-q3.material: Reaksi gas eksoterm ing ngisor iki ana ing kesetimbangan dinamis ing wadhah tertutup:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + panas (ΔH < 0).  Apa kondisi paling optimal sing kudu diatur kanggo ngasilake amonia (NH₃) kanthi maksimal ing kesetimbangan?
chemistry-h3-q3.thinking.0: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-h3-q3.s.s1.prompt: Reaksi gas eksoterm ing ngisor iki ana ing kesetimbangan dinamis ing wadhah tertutup:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + panas (ΔH < 0).  Apa kondisi paling optimal sing kudu diatur kanggo ngasilake amonia (NH₃) kanthi maksimal ing kesetimbangan?
chemistry-h3-q3.s.s1.explain: Amarga reaksi eksoterm ($\Delta H < 0$), suhu kudu diturunake supaya reaksi maju sing ngeculake panas dadi dominan. Uga, amarga mol gas suda saka $4\text{ mol} \rightarrow 2\text{ mol}$, tekanan kudu dimunggahake supaya kesetimbangan geser menyang reaksi maju sing nyuda jumlah molekul.

chemistry-h3-c.material: [Sifat koligatif larutan lanjutan] Pernyataan endi sing bener babagan sifat (sifat koligatif) larutan encer sing ngandhut zat terlarut nonvolatil lan nonelektrolit? (1) Mung sebanding karo jumlah partikel zat terlarut (molalitas), ora gumantung jinis zat terlarut. (2) Tekanan uap luwih endhek lan titik didhih luwih dhuwur tinimbang pelarut murni. (3) Rumus tekanan osmotik van 't Hoff Π = cRT meh padha karo persamaan keadaan gas ideal.

(3) Rumus tekanan osmotik van 't Hoff Π = cRT meh padha karo persamaan keadaan gas ideal.

chemistry-killer-12.title: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-killer-12.topic: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-killer-12.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-12.material: Ing 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ asam asetat ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) yaiku 4.7. Larutan penyangga digawe kanthi nyampur 100 mL $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ 0.20 M lan 100 mL $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ 0.10 M. Nalika 10 mL $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M ditambahake ing kono, pira pH larutan? (Owah-owahan konsentrasi amarga owah-owahan volume ora mengaruhi itungan rasio, lan nggunakake $\log 2 = 0.30$. Nalika dicampur, NaOH bereaksi kanthi lengkap karo asam asetat.)
chemistry-killer-12.thinking.0: Laju reaksi, prinsip Le Chatelier lan sel elektrokimia
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Ing 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ asam asetat ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) yaiku 4.7. Larutan penyangga digawe kanthi nyampur 100 mL $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ 0.20 M lan 100 mL $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ 0.10 M. Nalika 10 mL $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M ditambahake ing kono, pira pH larutan? (Owah-owahan konsentrasi amarga owah-owahan volume ora mengaruhi itungan rasio, lan nggunakake $\log 2 = 0.30$. Nalika dicampur, NaOH bereaksi kanthi lengkap karo asam asetat.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.explain:
Tahap 1: Mol wiwitan. HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (pH wiwitan = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 − 0.30 = 4.4).
Tahap 2: NaOH 1.0 M × 10 mL = 10 mmol → ing $\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$ HA suda 10 mmol, A⁻ mundhak 10 mmol. HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol.
Tahap 3: Amarga ana ing larutan sing padha, rasio konsentrasi = rasio mol = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
Jawaban: 5.0 (d). (Jawaban salah: 4.4 yaiku pH sadurunge NaOH ditambah, 4.7 yaiku kesalahan ngitung yen HA lan A⁻ dadi padha, lan 5.3 yaiku nilai sing ngitung rasio minangka 4)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-12.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
